title: Malformed anchor setter arguments crashed source validation

reproduction.before_fix: Checking source with anchor.setAttribute(); anchor.click(); threw a TypeError while the isolation scanner read the absent first argument.
reproduction.after_fix: The scanner checks both argument expressions before resolving the setter and returns a controlled failed security-isolation result when the destination is not certified.
reproduction.red_before_fix: The focused test failed with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading kind).

root_cause: Optional TypeScript AST call arguments were passed to resolveStaticStrings without checking whether the requested argument existed.
remediation: Validate the attribute and value arguments before static resolution. Missing values are treated as uncertified and fail closed through the standard registry-gate result.

validation.focused_regression: red before fix; passed after fix
